description: This Java class 'UtilCodec' provides utility methods for encoding, decoding, and sanitizing strings across various formats including HTML, XML, URL, and plain strings. It incorporates security features to prevent injection attacks such as XSS by sanitizing inputs with configurable policies and detecting potentially malicious content. The class also offers methods for canonicalization and validation of input strings, as well as wrappers for HTML-encoding maps.

classes.name: UtilCodec.HtmlEncoder
classes.description: Provides HTML encoding and sanitization methods utilizing owasp.html policies and configurable sanitization rules.

classes.name: UtilCodec.XmlEncoder
classes.description: Provides XML encoding by escaping entities relevant to XML content.

classes.name: UtilCodec.UrlCodec
classes.description: Implements URL encoding and decoding using UTF-8 encoding standards.

classes.name: UtilCodec.StringEncoder
classes.description: Performs simple string encoding, primarily escaping double quotes.

classes.name: UtilCodec.HtmlEncodingMapWrapper
classes.description: A Map wrapper that applies HTML encoding to string values and nested maps for safe rendering.

classes.name: UtilCodec.IntrusionException
classes.description: Custom exception class used during canonicalization to signal validation failures.

classes.name: UtilCodec.SimpleEncoder
classes.description: Interface for classes providing string encoding functionalities.

classes.name: UtilCodec.SimpleDecoder
classes.description: Interface for classes providing string decoding functionalities.

methods.name: getEncoder
methods.description: Returns a SimpleEncoder implementation based on the specified type.

methods.name: getDecoder
methods.description: Returns a SimpleDecoder implementation based on the specified type.

methods.name: canonicalize
methods.description: Performs input canonicalization to decode multiple or nested encodings and prevent injection attacks.

methods.name: checkStringForHtmlStrictNone
methods.description: Validates string against strict HTML-related security policies, checking for dangerous characters and scripts.

methods.name: checkStringForHtmlSafe
methods.description: Validates input HTML string for safety, utilizing configurable sanitization policies.

methods.name: encodeUrl
methods.description: Encodes a URL query string following OFBiz URL encoding rules.

methods.name: encodeUrl (overload)
methods.description: Encodes a URL query string with context-sensitive escaping based on provided context.

methods.name: HtmlEncodingMapWrapper.setup
methods.description: Initializes the map wrapper with a map and an encoder.
